correctness.rationale: Angular orthogonality gives exact compressed diagonal entries. The adjacent difference gives endpoint minimum. The crossing of strict ratio is unique; last-degree mass rises until its individual peak beyond the crossing while vacuum decreases. This proves global uniqueness. The N/e, logarithmic and thin-area expansions follow from moment balancing, bounded convergence, and Stirling. A standalone checker confirmed 1319 numerical identities; universal statements are analytic.

value.rationale: The least eigenvalue is a natural worst-case observability and stability invariant for every superposition of the first N+1 Hermite modes. The theorem provides its unique globally best fixed-area connected annulus, an exact degree-N location equation for every N,L, and a sharp exponentially small N→∞ energy law. This is a complete motivated constrained design problem, not an arbitrary table slice.
